subject: AIR specialization route ACK for audit; distinguish function constants from bound SPIR-V facts
body: Source-level ACK: tegu_air_library_specialize is the existing correct audit route for declared Metal FUNCTION constants. It clones Library, preserves other functions, replaces the selected function snapshot, checks declared type/required declarations and rejects duplicate named/indexed binding. Use cloned returned handle for the appropriate existing AIR compile entry and preserve input/output hashes. It is separate from SPIR-V specialization generated by runtime bound sampler/format/thread-region facts. New generic specialized native exports consume the latter per-stage maps; do not relabel a synthetic AIR function-constant choice as actual bound runtime state. No new production symbol needed solely for function-constant materialization. Frozen baseline bridge behavior/capacity remains evidence of that binary only; graphics native host specialization hash is available in lowering final board message, but full selected-category batch still needs root lease. Treat absent required values as unknown with explicitly finite synthetic exploration as proposed.
